subject.title: Auto-apply safe doctor fixes on gateway start

question: Which doctor repair subset, if any, may Gateway run automatically during startup without explicit operator action?
rationale: Current source intentionally keeps startup config repair read-only, while the issue discussion shows unattended `doctor --fix` can alter sandbox and Telegram availability; only maintainers can set the security and product boundary for automatic config mutation.

options.title: Opt-in vetted subset
options.body: Keep Gateway startup read-only by default, add a named opt-in mode for a maintainer-approved safe subset, and require redacted audit logs plus backups for every write.

options.title: Default safe migrations only
options.body: Allow a tiny always-on subset such as legacy schema migrations at startup, but explicitly exclude sandbox, channel, plugin, provider, and auth mutations.

options.title: Reject startup auto-repair
options.body: Keep all persisted doctor repairs behind explicit `openclaw doctor --fix` or supervisor `ExecStartPre` flows and improve warnings/status instead.

recommendation.title: Opt-in vetted subset
recommendation.body: Keep Gateway startup read-only by default, add a named opt-in mode for a maintainer-approved safe subset, and require redacted audit logs plus backups for every write.

likelyOwner.reason: The path history points to steipete across the gateway startup loader, doctor orchestration, and docs that define the current repair boundary.
